svg.title: Cedar Service release 1 architecture in five layers. Experience: Cedar Operations model-driven app, Customer Service workspace, dashboard, Site Check canvas app. Logic: business rules, business process flow, SLA and routing, plug-ins, cloud flows. Data: Dataverse tables Case, Site, Work order, Project, Account. Integration: FieldLink custom connector outbound and webhook Azure Function inbound through application user FieldLink Sync, with the external FieldLink API. Governance across all layers: CedarServiceCore solution, security roles and column security, auditing, data policies, pipelines and monitoring.

g.text: Cedar Service release 1: components by layer
C-04 Cedar Operations app (forms, views) · Customer Service workspace (OOB)
C-16 Cedar Service Overview dashboard · Site Check canvas app (lesson 23)
C-07 business rules WO-BR1..3, CASE-BR1 · C-08 dispatch BPF · C-05 routing · C-06 SLA
C-09 WorkOrderGuard plug-in · C-10 root-cause plug-in · C-11 First response flow
Account · Contact · C-03 Case · C-01 Site · C-02 Work order · Project
C-13 webhook Azure Function (inbound status) as app user FieldLink Sync
Arrows: outbound send to FieldLink; inbound status webhook back into Dataverse.
Rule: each component traces to at least one story, NFR or constraint.
